newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sommer Allibert sees higher 96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Sommer Allibert sees higher 96 profit.

text.p: French car parts maker Sommer Allibert said on Wednesday it expected higher 1996 profits thanks to an advance in sales and stable raw material prices.

"The good trend in sales in the second and third quarters, stability in raw materials prices and the sharply lower launch costs in the second quarter should allow the group to show 1996 results higher than those for 1995," the company said in a statement with first-half results.
The company earlier reported first-half net attributable profit down 30.1 percent at 141.9 million francs.
